notes.title: Build 1.2.8 Live
notes.content:
This update fix's the following:

1. Changing Fullscreen/windowed mode & resolution. 
2. FOV & Audio settings.
3. Collision issues in the RMS maps going into third class.
4. HMHS Regal collision issue.
5. Non existing stair collision in HMHS Night Free cam.
6. Mouse hiding in the legal page of the menu.

The game breaking issue of the game crashing when changing the resolution was actually due to the version of the UE4 engine the game used, not the programing of the game itself. This bug was tied to how the engine used DirectX 11 when changing screen modes. The only solution for fixing this was migrating the entire game to a different version of the engine.

Since this newer version of the engine changes how UE4 does lighting, all of the levels needed adjusting so they were not extremely bright. The levels should more or less match how they looked in the old version's of the game.

This migration also broke a number of small things such as Robin and Info box's, but all should be working fine now.

As always please let us know is this caused some new bugs in other aspects of the game!

Everyone stay safe!

notes.title: Build 1.2.3 Live
notes.content:
The latest build is now live, and it will be a large update.

You can read on the full situation in our Guarantee Group, but in short a new project was generated during the making of this re haul to the UI, so steam will see each file as "new" and replace all previous game files. This is why the update is around 8 GB.

Here is a brief summary on what has changed:

1. New UI: The old UI system never worked as intended and instead of using duck tape to try and fix it, a new menu system was put in place that should clean up any bugs & issues the old one had. Such as FOV & audio setting's resetting each time a level was loaded.
2. Bug Fix's: over the last two months, all major bugs reported here or in the Guarantee Group have been dealt with for the most part. This includes the major issue of being in the RMS Regal suite teleporting you in the bathroom, GSC lighting issues & broken gates in the exterior tour.
3. Sailing Level: Because of the demand of people wanting back the dedicated night time exterior levels, they have been added back but with a twist. The level has been modified so the ship is constantly sailing forever. This is for both RMS & HMHS levels. 

This should fix most issues regarding the game in terms of a functioning standpoint. However since the game was migrated to a new project, its possible some new issues will show up.

Please report any major issues you see either here or in our Guarantee Group in order to be seen and addressed.

It should also be noted currently this update is only for windows users only at this time. A Mac version of the update hopefully should come down the road.

Have a great day!

notes.title: Updates In The Future
notes.content:
We are still working on some updates to improve or address some more feedback we have gotten from customers.

Here is a run down on what hopefully will be coming soon in some future updates

1) A re-hauled UI: As everyone is probably aware, there are a number of problems with the current UI & menu system, especially in the settings department. It was decided that rather than trying to make this not so great system working with a duck tape method, a new more streamlined and robust menu system was going to be needed. Thus a whole new UI will be coming down the road that will hopefully fix most of the problems currently present.

2)Bug Fixes: People have been reporting a few more small bugs, ranging from a problem in the hmhs B Deck suite, problems with the RMS Night time mode with interiors and some spelling mistakes. These are being worked on and will probably be released as a minor update prior to the new UI.

Once these two main issue's are addressed, that should be it in terms of any major updates needing for the desktop versions. Currently for the VR build, a method for trying to get teleportation and locomotion movement in the same game is being worked on but there are no guarantees that this will work, but hopefully can also be added in the future.

Currently our interior modelers are busy making cabins and other spaces for Titanic and is unknown when they will be getting the time to add any new spaces to Britannic ATM, but these next bunch of updates should fix any regarding functionality problems with the game.

Again we want to thank our fans for supporting this game and as always be sure to leave feedback and bug findings, we do indeed read your feedback and try to implement or change things that we can to make it better.

Have a great day!

notes.title: Build 1.1.3 For Mac Live
notes.content:
Mac users have had to wait a while, but the current PC build is now live for Mac users.

The major thing missing from launch for Mac users was no RMS Exterior, this was due to how last minute the exterior was added to the game and there was no time to get a Mac build. It was decided to wait a little while before doing more builds for Mac due to the time it takes to do one for Apple products.

Let us know if there are any problems with this update.

notes.title: Build 1.1.1 Live
notes.content:
EDIT: Some last tweaks from a few more bugs people have found are being fixed and a 1.1.2 build is going live.

This update will be one of the last for a while, it fixes a number of things found in build 1.1.0.

Standard:

Missing Lights In Exterior Tour: People found a number of lights and random things that did not switch over properly during the day/night levels.

Info Box's: A few glitches were found in the new info box's, all ones reported were fixed.

Menu Problems: The Main and in game menu's where you can switch to the new exterior levels were swapped. 

The new FOV fix also introduced a new problem were each time if you went into the options, it reset it to 50. This has been fixed, though the slider bar will reset if you leave the options and come back. It wont automatically force the change if you simply enter the options menu anymore, but the slider will not reflect the change you made, even though it is actually working. This issue is still being worked on though in all honesty, this will probably be fixed in a re haul in the menu down the road as the current one has alot of problems and a better one will be found at a later point in time.

In Game Level Trigger's: A few of the in game level triggers had some problems, this has been fixed as well as a few more added to cabins.

VR: 

Jump Feature: This has now been put into the exterior tour mode for ease of use. The info box toggle button has also been moved to the left controller face button.

Glossy Tiles: A few people have expressed feedback on the GSC Tiles in this version, that they are very sparkly and white near windows.

Since VR requires graphics and settings to be lowered to ensure performance, this can cause graphical artifacts to appear that dont appear in the standard version. Since shadows and AA are toned down, this causes the light from the windows to be very bright on the tile. The tile shine and other effects have been removed to fix this problem.

Turning: To make it a little easier, the turning in VR has been changed again to 10 degrees to allow more flexibility.

Also as a reminder, you can in the main menu level of VR hit F11 to toggle a windowed mode, allowing you to hide the HMD mirror to save a few frames if desired.


Mac users will be getting this version of the game and should be live in a day or two.

Thanks everyone for the feedback and keep up the good work on keeping Britannic's memory alive and her story popular to ensure future work is done on the wreck!

notes.title: Build 1.1.0 Live
notes.content:
EDIT: Some small things have already been found, a quick update will happen tomorrow to correct this.

This update will be the last major update for a while as we take a little break, this update should help address previous feedback/bugs to the best of our ability at this time.

Standard:

1) 3D models & Textures changed: Due to further historical work, some minor changes have occurred both in the exterior and in the inside to better reflect some new stuff found post launch or model problems discovered by our players.

2) GSC Optimization: Some further changes and tweaks done to the RMS GSC that should help a little in boosting performance with some more level streaming and other small changes.

3) Interior Level Changing: While currently you cannot effortlessly go from space to space as that would require us to model the connecting parts and many of these spaces are uniquely Britannic and cant be copy/pasted from Titanic. However due to the huge amount of feedback from players to streamline this even a little bit, in the pause menu during interior exploration you can now select the interior locations, thus eliminating the need to always go to the main menu to switch locations.

Select doors in the exterior tour mode and in the two GSC maps also have the ability to hit a trigger so you can go to a set location when appropriate. This feature is not in the VR version due to some issues.

4) Day/Night Cycle: In order to clean up the menus a little and also give our player's a unlimited amount of different angle and lighting shots. The exterior tour modes for both exploration and free camera mode now have a fully operational day/night cycle, complete with lights turning off and on. This eliminates the need to have separate maps and also allows some very nice sunset and sunrise shots. The shift between the two is 10 minutes each (10 Minutes for day time, and 10 minutes for night)

This and point #3 will be also listed in the main menu for a short time in case people dont read this announcement.

5) FOV, Music and Sensitivity Sliders: A annoying bug in the previous versions was all three of these would either reset upon opening a new level or simply not work. The Music and SFX sliders now keep the desired setting for the entire game as does the FOV Slider. The Vertical and Horizontal sliders still have a few issues, they do work but only when you are in a game mode and change the desired , and it will stick  for that level. This will be continued to be worked on in the future.

6) Missing animations in the Free Camera Sinking: The telegraph handles in this mode did not move during the sinking, this has been fixed. There are also a few lifeboat crank animations that are broken, these will be fixed in a future update.

7) Missing Collision: Some people have reported some missing wall collision in select interior spaces, this has been corrected.

8) More info box's added to the exterior levels!


VR:

1) The above mentioned day and night cycle has replaced the 4 exterior levels.

2) Some further optimization in the GSC: Nothing big but each bit helps it slightly.

3) Fixed Collision on the well deck: Some people reported problems getting out of the well deck, this has been fixed.

4) In case some people missed it last time, a jump mechanic has been added to the VR version to make it easier to go around the sinking.


Mac:

The above mentioned updates will be coming to Mac users after the weekend, this will include the RMS exterior levels, this was not put into the Mac build due to the last minute nature of getting it in before launch. A announcement will be made regarding this update going live.


We thank everyone here for the continued support and all the feedback said in the reviews. We are trying to implement as much as we can into the game now and for future projects to give you the best experience and improve the enjoyment factor.

Keep finding those bugs and have a wonderful day!

notes.title: Build 1.0.95 Live
notes.content:
A number of big changes.

Standard:

1) More optimization has been done to the GSC levels, level streaming has been introduced that should help the most in RMS GSC, though a bit has been added to HMHS GSC. The Playroom was going to be also streamed to help with performance but in its current state it was too long of a load period, this area will be level streamed in next update. Even without that, this should help people with lower end systems as now some major chunks of the staircase is not loaded all the time when on anything but A deck.

Let us know if this helps anyone at all.

2) Some more Texture, material and bugs have been fixed that have been found by players in the past few days.

3) Some material and furniture changes to reflect some historical details & photos.

4) At the request of players, the load times with the text has been shortened to make it less annoying to go from space to space.

VR:

1) The above mentioned updates, including GSC level streaming, This should help with performance in VR, particular in the RMS GSC level.

2) Further optimization changes and engine tweaking should help with performance even more.

3) Pressing F11 at the main menu will now let you toggle the HMD mirroring, allowing you to make it smaller or hide it all together to make performance increase even more.

4) At the feedback of players, the turn angle for VR has been changed to 15 degrees to make it more flexible to turn without having to rotate your body more.

5) At the request of alot of people, a jumping feature has been added to the sinking levels, allowing you to more easily roam parts of the ship or lifeboats during the sinking.


Planned Updates/Features

1) The Music, SFX & Toggle features in the options menu in the standard version are not saving after leaving a level, and reset. This is being looked into and will hopefully be in the next wave of updates.

2) It has been requested for a walk/run toggle much like in Demo 3, and also to have a crouch option to make it easier to go up some stairs during the sinking. Both features are being looked into being added.

3) More level streaming in the GSC will hopefully be added to help improve performance of it more for lower end computers.

Please let us know if any of the current updates made any difference for both VR and Standard in terms of performance.

notes.title: Build 1.0.93 Live
notes.content:
Standard:

Invisible wall appearing in the sinking free camera mode has been fixed.

Gap in Scotland road door has been fixed.

Texture and material changes.

Wonky starboard RMS Exterior gate has been fixed.

FOV limit has been increased (though it saving for the all levels has not yet been fixed)

VR:

Previous updates applied.

After feedback, the VR system has been altered until a more permanent solution can be found. Speed of player has been increased and full 360 locomotion has been added to the left thumbstick. In order to help with motion sickness, the right thumbstick now turns in intervals instead of a smooth motion.

Anti Aliasing has been changed to a different one to help eliminate artifacts appearing, while no FPS drop was found in testing, changing this could have a impact. Let us know if this is the case.

A number of changes have been done to FPS settings and some graphic settings to help with performance in VR. A change for the better was noticed on our end, let us know if any meaningful improvements were noticed for others.

Mac and more updates to come in the following days.

notes.title: Game Crashing After Changing Fullscreen Option
notes.content:
Shortly after launch a bug was found when someone went to change the fullscreen option, it would crash the game and then cause the game to crash when attempting to re-launch.

While a update came out for it, some people may still have the game crash on launch. The reason for this is that the graphic settings are stored locally on the computer and it remembers the last settings that was chosen.

To reset the settings and fix the game, the following solution has helped a number of People.

1. Go to your C: Drive, then the "Users" folder, then the user folder that is currently logged into the computer.

2. in the windows file explorer address bar, type \appdata at the end of the current location and then go into the local folder. The full address should look something like this. "C:\Users\user\AppData\Local" (\user\ is the name of the user logged in)

3. Once in the local folder, find the Britannic folder and delete it, boot the game up and it should reset the graphic options and let you play and change settings again.
